title: Grateful Dead Live at Alpine Valley Music Theatre on 1982-08-08

ai_review.summary: Crisp soundboard recording captures a high‑energy Alpine Valley show highlighted by a smoking Satisfaction/​Wang Dang Doodle closer, trippy Space→Other One and a standout Scarlet▶Fire jam.
ai_review.review: The August 8, 1982 Alpine Valley performance is remembered for its loose, electrifying vibe – Jerry’s guitar was on fire, the band took daring jams (Space → The Other One, Scarlet > Fire) and delivered an unforgettable Satisfaction finale with a surprise Wang Dang Doodle rap.  The soundboard source is praised as crystal‑clear with excellent drum mix, making the show highly listenable despite occasional vocal flubs.

ai_rating.rationale: The majority of reviews are 4–5 stars and emphasize strong musical moments and excellent soundboard quality; only a few low‑rating outliers mention minor flaws.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Crisp, clear mix with superb snare/drum balance; bass a touch light for some listeners but overall very clean. Minor vocal flubs noted on Estimated; no major drop‑outs or distortion.

show_quality.setlist_flow: The first set builds with energetic openers (Alabama Getaway, Promised Land) and tight mid‑set numbers; the second set rockets after Far From Me, featuring expansive jams that keep momentum high through the encore.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Described as ‘on fire’, with strong guitar tone and vocal presence throughout the show.
band_member_comments.Phil: Noted as somewhat subdued in the mix; solid bass work but less prominent than usual.
band_member_comments.Bob: Praised for a playful Satisfaction closer, incorporating improvised rap lyrics; occasional vocal flubs mentioned.
band_member_comments.Keys: Brent’s piano work highlighted as tasteful and distinctive (especially on LLRain and Peggy‑O).
band_member_comments.Drums: Mickey Hart and Bill Kreutzmann receive high praise for fluid playing and a perfect snare mix; guest percussionist Zakir Hussein adds excitement to the drum jam.
